This document reproduces the tables and figures of the paper from the Parquet files written in Step 3 of the README (`results/parquet_v2/`, `results/original_predictions_v2/`, `results/hyperparameters_v2/` and `results/evaluation_v2/`). Render it from the repository root:

```bash
quarto render results/scripts/figures_and_tables.qmd
```

The code for Figures 4–7 and S-Figures 10–11, 22–25 and 30–31 will be added in a later update.


# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme
library(ggplot2)

# Use one visual style and palette throughout the manuscript.
dark2_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")

options(
  ggplot2.discrete.colour = dark2_palette,
  ggplot2.discrete.fill = dark2_palette
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = grey(0.95), color = NA)
    )
)

fmt_percent <- function(x, accuracy = 0.1) {
  scales::percent(x, accuracy = accuracy)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-data
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(pROC)

evaluation_results <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "evaluation_v2")
) |>
  collect()

original_predictions <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "original_predictions_v2")
) |>
  collect()

evaluation_manifest <- read_parquet(
  here::here("results", "evaluation_v2_manifest.parquet")
)

# Keep the larger sample size first, as in the version 1 figures.
sample_sizes <- c(458L, 229L)
sample_size_labels <- paste0("N = ", sample_sizes)

model_levels <- c("Elastic Net", "Random Forest")

method_labels <- c(
  bootstrap = "Non-param. boot",
  bootstrap_par = "Parametric boot",
  bootstrap_635 = "Out-of-bag boot",
  cross_validation_10 = "10-fold CV",
  cross_validation_5 = "5-fold CV",
  cross_validation_2 = "2-fold CV",
  independent = "Independent"
)

method_colors <- c(
  setNames(dark2_palette[1:6], unname(method_labels[1:6])),
  "Independent" = "black"
)

metric_labels <- c(
  variance = "variance",
  pi_width = "95% range width",
  MAPE = "MAPE",
  tMAPE = "tMAPE",
  q025 = "2.5th %",
  q975 = "97.5th %"
)

evaluation_results <- evaluation_results |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    ),
    model_label = factor(
      model,
      levels = c("glmnet", "random_forest"),
      labels = model_levels
    ),
    method_label = factor(
      method,
      levels = names(method_labels),
      labels = unname(method_labels)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(sample_size_label, method, model, id, iter)

original_predictions <- original_predictions |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    ),
    model_label = factor(
      model,
      levels = c("glmnet", "random_forest"),
      labels = model_levels
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(sample_size_label, model, iter, id)


auc_by_iteration <- original_predictions |>
  summarise(
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(y, original_pred_p, quiet = TRUE)),
    .by = c(sample_size, sample_size_label, model, model_label, dgm, iter)
  )

auc_summary <- auc_by_iteration |>
  summarise(
    mean_AUC = mean(AUC),
    lower = quantile(AUC, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(AUC, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size, sample_size_label, model, model_label, dgm)
  )

primary_metrics <- c("variance", "pi_width", "MAPE", "tMAPE")
comparison_metrics <- c(primary_metrics, "q025", "q975")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-independent-auc
#| cache: true

# AUCs of models fitted to independently sampled data and applied to the
# corresponding original dataset.
oob_auc_indep <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "parquet_v2")
) |>
  filter(method == "independent") |>
  select(sample_size, dgm, model, iter, re_sample, y, pred_p) |>
  collect() |>
  summarise(
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(y, pred_p, quiet = TRUE)),
    .by = c(sample_size, dgm, model, iter, re_sample)
  )

# Boxplot summaries of AUCs pooled across iterations.
oob_auc_indep_summary <- oob_auc_indep |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(
    lower_whisker = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[1],
    lower_hinge = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[2],
    median_AUC = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[3],
    upper_hinge = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[4],
    upper_whisker = boxplot.stats(AUC)$stats[5],
    mean_AUC = mean(AUC),
    lower = quantile(AUC, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(AUC, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size, sample_size_label, model, dgm)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-comparisons
# Reshape the reference and practical-procedure results to one metric per row.
reference_results <- evaluation_results |>
  filter(method == "independent") |>
  select(
    sample_size,
    sample_size_label,
    model,
    model_label,
    dgm,
    iter,
    id,
    all_of(comparison_metrics)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(comparison_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "reference"
  )

comparison_results <- evaluation_results |>
  filter(method != "independent") |>
  select(
    sample_size,
    sample_size_label,
    model,
    model_label,
    method,
    method_label,
    dgm,
    iter,
    id,
    true_p,
    original_pred_p,
    all_of(comparison_metrics)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(comparison_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    reference_results,
    by = c(
      "sample_size",
      "sample_size_label",
      "model",
      "model_label",
      "dgm",
      "iter",
      "id",
      "metric"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = estimate - reference,
    absolute_difference = abs(difference),
    rel_difference = estimate / reference,
    rel_abs_difference = absolute_difference / reference,
    metric_label = factor(
      metric,
      levels = names(metric_labels),
      labels = unname(metric_labels)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-event-fractions
event_smry <- original_predictions |>
  distinct(sample_size, dgm, iter, id, y) |>
  summarise(event_fraction = mean(y), .by = c(sample_size, dgm, iter)) |>
  summarise(
    mean_ef = mean(event_fraction),
    min = min(event_fraction),
    max = max(event_fraction),
    lower = quantile(event_fraction, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(event_fraction, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size, dgm)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-reference-summary
reference_by_iteration <- evaluation_results |>
  filter(method == "independent") |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(primary_metrics), mean),
    .by = c(sample_size_label, model_label, dgm, iter)
  )

reference_summary <- reference_by_iteration |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(primary_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    lower = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .by = c(sample_size_label, model_label, dgm, metric)
  )
```

# Main text

## Table 3

**Table 3.** Prediction instability under independent sampling.

```{r}
#| label: table-3
reference_table <- reference_summary |>
  mutate(
    value = if_else(
      metric == "variance",
      sprintf("%.4f [%.4f, %.4f]", mean, lower, upper),
      sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", mean, lower, upper)
    ),
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = primary_metrics,
      labels = unname(metric_labels[primary_metrics])
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    `Sample size` = sample_size_label,
    Model = model_label,
    DGM = dgm,
    metric,
    value
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Sample size`, values_from = value)

reference_table |>
  select(-Model) |>
  kbl(
    format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = "lcc"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "hold_position",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  collapse_rows(column = 1, latex_hline = "none") |>
  # Use lighter separators within each DGM and grey between DGMs.
  row_spec(
    c(1:3, 5:7, 9:11, 13:15),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{lightgray}\\cmidrule{2-4}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid lightgrey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    c(4, 12),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{gray}\\cmidrule{1-4}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid grey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(8, extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule{1-4}") |>
  group_rows("Elastic Net", 1, 8) |>
  group_rows("Random Forest", 9, 16)
```

## Figure 1

**Figure 1.** Individual-level prediction instability under independent sampling across the true (DGM) outcome probability range.

```{r}
#| label: figure-1
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8.8

instability_risk_plot <- subset(evaluation_results, method == "independent") |>
  pivot_longer(
    all_of(primary_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric_label = factor(
      metric,
      levels = primary_metrics,
      labels = unname(metric_labels[primary_metrics])
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = true_p,
    y = value,
    color = model_label,
    linetype = sample_size_label,
    fill = model_label
  )) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(metric_label),
    cols = vars(dgm),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value",
    color = "Model",
    fill = "Model",
    linetype = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black"))
  )

# Count each simulated person once, independently of the fitted model.
risk_distribution_data <- original_predictions |>
  filter(model == "glmnet", sample_size == 458)

risk_distribution_plot <- ggplot(risk_distribution_data, aes(true_p)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.025,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "grey60",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(dgm)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "True (DGM) risk", y = "Count") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

cowplot::plot_grid(
  instability_risk_plot,
  risk_distribution_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr",
  rel_heights = c(6, 1)
)
```

## Figures 2 and 3

Plotting function used for Figures 2–3 and S-Figures 12–21.

```{r}
#| label: agreement-plot-function
plot_agreement <- function(metric_name, dgm_name = "linear") {
  plot_data <- comparison_results |>
    filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      dgm == dgm_name
    )

  plot_limits <- range(
    c(plot_data$reference, plot_data$estimate),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(reference, estimate)) +
    geom_bin_2d(bins = 100) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = grey(0.5), linewidth = 0.25) +
    # facet_grid(
    #   rows = vars(method_label),
    #   cols = vars(model_label, sample_size_label)
    # ) +
    ggh4x::facet_nested(
      rows = vars(method_label),
      cols = vars(model_label, sample_size_label),
      nest_line = element_line(color = "white", linewidth = 1),
      strip = ggh4x::strip_nested(
        text_x = list(
          element_text(margin = margin(b = 5, t = 3)), # model labels
          element_text(margin = margin(b = 3, t = 5)) # sample-size labels
        ),
        by_layer_x = TRUE
      )
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = plot_limits, ylim = plot_limits) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
    labs(
      x = "Independent sampling",
      y = "Resampling procedure",
      fill = "Count"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

**Figure 2.** Agreement with independent sampling for empirical 95% range width, linear DGM.

```{r}
#| label: figure-2
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 9

plot_agreement("pi_width", "linear") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = c(seq(0, 0.8, 0.2), "")
  )
```

**Figure 3.** Agreement with independent sampling for empirical 95% range width, non-linear DGM.

```{r}
#| label: figure-3
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 9

plot_agreement("pi_width", "nonlinear") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = c(seq(0, 0.8, 0.2), "")
  )
```

# Supplementary material

## S-Table 1

**S-Table 1.** Model performance in the original datasets.

```{r}
#| label: s-table-1
initial_performance_table <- auc_summary |>
  left_join(
    select(
      oob_auc_indep_summary,
      sample_size,
      dgm,
      model,
      independent_mean_AUC = mean_AUC,
      independent_lower = lower,
      independent_upper = upper
    ),
    by = c("sample_size", "dgm", "model")
  ) |>
  left_join(event_smry, by = c("sample_size", "dgm")) |>
  arrange(desc(sample_size), dgm, model) |>
  transmute(
    `Sample\nsize` = sample_size_label,
    DGM = dgm,
    `Event fraction` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      mean_ef,
      lower.y,
      upper.y
    ),
    Model = model_label,
    `AUC\nin-sample` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      mean_AUC,
      lower.x,
      upper.x
    ),
    `AUC\nindependent-sample` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      independent_mean_AUC,
      independent_lower,
      independent_upper
    )
  )

initial_performance_table %>%
  kbl(
    format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
    col.names = kableExtra::linebreak(colnames(.), align = "c"),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "lllccc"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "hold_position",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = c(1:3), valign = "middle", latex_hline = "none") |>
  # Use light grey between models and grey between DGMs.
  row_spec(
    c(1, 3, 5, 7),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{lightgray}\\cmidrule{4-6}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid lightgrey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    c(2, 6),
    extra_latex_after = "\\arrayrulecolor{gray}\\cmidrule{2-6}\\arrayrulecolor{black}",
    extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid grey;"
  ) |>
  row_spec(4, extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule{1-6}")
```

## S-Figure 1

**S-Figure 1.** AUCs of models fitted to independently sampled development data and applied to the initial datasets.

```{r}
#| label: s-figure-1
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8.7

oob_auc_indep |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = iter, y = AUC, group = iter)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = oob_auc_indep_summary,
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = lower_whisker,
      ymax = upper_whisker
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = oob_auc_indep_summary,
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = lower_hinge,
      ymax = upper_hinge
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.20
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(size = 0.35, width = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(
    data = oob_auc_indep_summary,
    aes(yintercept = median_AUC),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    sample_size_label + dgm ~ model,
    labeller = labeller(
      model = c(glmnet = "Elastic Net", random_forest = "Random Forest"),
      dgm = c(linear = "linear DGM", nonlinear = "non-linear DGM")
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20)) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial dataset",
    y = "AUC on the original dataset"
  )
```

## S-Figures 4 to 9

**S-Figure 4.** Calibration of models fitted on the first independent sample, linear DGM.

```{r}
#| label: s-figure-4
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| cache: true
res_re1 <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "parquet_v2")
) |>
  filter(re_sample == 1) |>
  select(id, method, sample_size, dgm, model, iter, re_sample, y, pred_p) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    ),
    model_label = factor(
      model,
      levels = c("glmnet", "random_forest"),
      labels = model_levels
    ),
    method_label = factor(
      method,
      levels = names(method_labels),
      labels = unname(method_labels)
    )
  )

res_re1 %>%
  filter(method == "independent", dgm == "linear") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = pred_p,
    y = y
  )) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    color = grey(0.75),
    linewidth = 0.25,
    aes(group = interaction(sample_size, model, iter, re_sample))
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +

    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,

    color = "#0072B2",
    linewidth = 0.8

  facet_grid(rows = vars(sample_size_label), cols = vars(model_label)) +

```

```{r}
#| cache: true

res_re1 %>%
  filter(sample_size == 458 & grepl("bootstrap", method) & dgm == "linear") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = pred_p,
    y = y
  )) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    color = grey(0.75),
    linewidth = 0.25,
    aes(group = interaction(sample_size, model, iter, re_sample))
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "#0072B2",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(method_label), cols = vars(model_label)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Estimated risk", y = "Observed outcome")
```

## S-Figures 26 to 29

**S-Figure 26.** Hyperparameters selected for the original elastic net fits, linear DGM.

```{r}
#| label: s-figure-26
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

library(patchwork)

glmnet_hyperparameters <- open_dataset(
  here::here("results", "hyperparameters_v2"),
  unify_schemas = TRUE
) |>
  filter(dgm == "linear", model == "glmnet") |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(desc(sample_size), iter) |>
  mutate(
    sample_size_label = factor(
      sample_size,
      levels = sample_sizes,
      labels = sample_size_labels
    )
  )

glmnet_scatter <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters,
  aes(x = alpha, y = lambda, color = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.015, height = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "Alpha", y = "Lambda", color = "Sample size")

glmnet_alpha_histogram <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters,
  aes(alpha, fill = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50,
    boundary = -0.05,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

glmnet_lambda_histogram <- ggplot(
  glmnet_hyperparameters,
  aes(lambda, fill = sample_size_label)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

(glmnet_alpha_histogram + plot_spacer()) /
  (glmnet_scatter + glmnet_lambda_histogram) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1), heights = c(1, 4))
```
